_UNSUPPORTED_SCHEMA_WARNING: WARNING — DO NOT IMPORT THIS FILE DIRECTLY. This JSON is a CONCEPTUAL reference describing the desired MIME / extension restrictions. It does NOT match the Power Platform DLP Admin API schema and will be rejected by DLP import cmdlets/APIs. Power Platform DLP policies operate on connectors (Business / Non-business / Blocked classifications), not on file extensions or MIME types directly. To translate the intent below into a real DLP policy: classify connectors that allow uploads of risky file types (e.g., HTTP, custom connectors that exchange binary payloads) into the Blocked or Non-business group through the Power Platform admin center. The actual MIME-type enforcement is performed by the ValidateMimeType plugin in src/, not by this template.
